_meta.title: Runtime configuration for the outbound-click counter
_meta.note: This file is the only place the counter's runtime behaviour is set. tools/build_analytics.py turns it into assets/analytics.js. Nothing here is a product fact; it is configuration, and it is reviewed like everything else in this repository.

endpoint_note: Empty means: no request leaves the visitor's browser. Events are kept in the reader's own browser until an owner-controlled collector is configured here. Set this to the collector's /e URL to start sending.
queue_note: The queue is capped and aged out so an unused browser does not keep growing a record the owner never receives.
